author: reek
body: `codex/test/reverse-reverse` proves the founding flagship over a `MyList` it declares itself, and it had to: induction resolves the variable's type to a variant, the foreword's `List` is a builtin with no constructors to case on, and Stage 5 therefore accepted any induction over it as an unproven axiom (CDX4022). The same lemma chain is proved here over `Foreword chapter InductiveList`, which is a variant Stage 5 can walk.

author: reek
body: The instrument: this file must compile with NO CDX4022. A warning would mean the proofs were accepted rather than checked, which is the exact failure the entry describes -- so `inductive-list.diag` would be the wrong tool here, and the negative guard lives in `codex/test/errors/induction-list-false` where a false claim over this same type must be a hard error.

author: reek
body: The round trip is here so the chapter is exercised at runtime as well as proved at compile time. The proofs erase at emit, so without this the binary would contain nothing this file is about.
